Casa de Campo — Madrid, Spain

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Casa de Campo park has a long, well-documented history of street prostitution stretching back over a decade, covered repeatedly by local outlets and the subject of a formal citizen petition. In 2025 a wave of robberies targeting cars and visitors in parking areas was reported, including a first-person victim account. From around 2020 onward, resident complaints of robberies, threats and assaults were also linked to a former minors' shelter near the park. Daytime family/jogger use is largely uneventful, but night-time concerns are well documented. Sources checked: Telemadrid, 'Prostitucion en la Casa de Campo' series; Decide Madrid citizen petition; Telemadrid & El Espanol, Jun 2025 (robbery wave); Vozpopuli, 2020-2021.
